Zones for Ref Rogue

Ranked by skill-ups first, then by the prices you've entered and today's conditions. Only zones up to level 17 are included. Tap a zone for when, where and why.

1. Darkshore
10–20
Earthroot, Mageroyal, Briarthorn, Stranglekelp, Light Leather, Light Hide, Ruined Leather Scraps, Medium Leather, Medium Hide
WHEN
Now. Level 10–20 fits you, so you can quest here while you gather.
Herbalism skill-ups from Mageroyal, Briarthorn and Stranglekelp until about 135 (you're at 90).
Skinning skill-ups from Medium Leather and Medium Hide until about 125 (you're at 80).
Quiet: most players have moved past this zone, so nodes stay up. Any time works.
Sell what you gather at Tue 7 PM (Briarthorn +12% vs now).
WHERE
Kalimdor, your faction's territory.
Dense: ≈202 herb nodes in its best bracket, among the top zones in Wowhead's Forever data.
Skin Giant Foreststriders, Foreststriders, Elder Darkshore Threshers and Moonstalker Sires (about level 14–18) around The Master's Glaive, Grove of the Ancients and Remtravel's Excavation for Light and Medium Leather. Good skill-ups for you.
WHY
5 node types still give skill-ups.
Both your gathering professions work here (Herbalism and Skinning), so nothing you pass is wasted.
Medium Leather is worth about 3s 61c each today, roughly 1g 28s an hour if you gathered only that.
